consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM asks 'is the required count of the contract item present in the player's crafting_inventory?' and returns that yes/no to the mission-completion machinery.
scope: items reachable via the player's crafting_inventory() (carried items plus nearby reachable items), not just on-person carried items and not the raw ground-stack export
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — its body calls u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback) and returns the resulting boolean as the completion verdict
divergence: A scrap stack sits on a nearby but unreachable tile (e.g. behind a wall/closed window): it appears in arcopolis_export write_entities items[], so a tally of the raw ground dump reports the contract complete, but crafting_inventory() cannot reach it so the real is_complete returns false — the re-derivation falsely says 'all there yet'.
